QuestInfo.name: The Fairy Queen
QuestInfo.0: The White Mage was supposedly last seen in Ellin Forest. If that's true, there must be evidence.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Ephenia the Fairy Queen.\r\n#b(Find the Fairy Queen's Nest in Ellin Forest.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You met Ephenia the Fairy Queen. She made her dislike of humans abundantly clear.

1.0: What do YOU want? Come to peddle your inferior human wares? Because YOU have NOTHING that I want.\r\n#L0##b(Talk about the dark monsters.)#l\n#k
1.1: Dark monsters? What of them? They're hardly as vile as you humans, what with your stealing and kidnapping.\r\n#L0##b(Talk about the White Mage.)#l\n#k
1.2: #b(Ephenia's look softens a bit when she hears the name.)#k\r\nWhite Mage...? W-what business do you have with the White Mage?

yes.0: He was the one good human that I met in my life. I liked to watch him study magic... He was an idealist, and his passion was incomparable. I know he will make the world a much better place.
yes.1: But...I can't just tell you where he is. I don't even know who you are.
